To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The integration of users’ meta features, textual content, and images in a single model is beneficial for the prediction of personality traits; and 2) The integration of two social networking sites (i.e. Twitter and Instagram) is also beneficial.

(1) the joint analysis of text and image features from Twitter and Instagram leads to a consistent decrease in prediction errors for each Big 5 personality trait and (2) the joint analysis is able to predict users’ personality traits better than the analysis of the individual features.

(i) the fusion of users’ social media data from two different S NSs leads to an improvement of personality prediction accuracy and (ii) the integration of image and text features from Instagram and Twitter, respectively, is more beneficial than the integration of users’ meta features (e.g. followers, following, etc.).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fusion of users’ social media cues for personality prediction.
fusing users’ digital traces from different SNSs to predict personality traits.
the fusion of social media cues for personality prediction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fusion of the two SNSs’ data is a promising direction for personality prediction, and the results of this paper can be used as a starting point for more in-depth studies in the future.
the joint analysis leads to a consistent reduction of the prediction errors.
the integration of the two SNSs leads to a more robust personality prediction, and the integration of the different types of features leads to more accurate personality prediction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the integration of users’ digital footprints from different SNSs can improve personality trait prediction.
fusing information from multiple SNSs can improve personality predictions, but the extent of the improvement depends on the specific SNSs and the specific personality trait.

we are able to predict the five personality traits (i.e., Openness to Experience, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Neuroticism) from the users’ activities on Twitter and Instagram with an average error of 0.45, 0.45 and 0.44 respectively.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the joint analysis and fusion of users’ activities from different SNSs can lead to more accurate personality predictions.
the integration of information from multiple SNSs can lead to more reliable personality predictions.
the joint analysis can be a promising way for personality prediction.
